provenance.derivation_note: Measured (Seppälä 2002, Table 4, K63 port): group-integrated fluence rates thermal 7.19e7, epithermal (0.5 eV-10 keV) 1.07e9, fast (>10 keV) 3.45e7 n cm^-2 s^-1 at the 14 cm aperture; bin weights are the measured group fractions of the 1.1769e9 total. Assumed, not measured: within-group spectral shape is uniform per bin (the resolved spectrum is published only as figures); beam divergence is a uniform-in-solid-angle cone with half-angle atan(7/46.6) = 0.1491 rad, the geometric bound of the 46.6 cm Bi collimator; position is uniform over the aperture. Group boundaries follow the IAEA TECDOC-1223 convention (thermal <0.5 eV, epithermal 0.5 eV-10 keV, fast >10 keV); the 1.69e7 eV upper edge is the fission-spectrum endpoint used by the source reference. This is a literature reconstruction, not a validated facility model: the published J/Phi = 0.77 beam-quality ratio is a separate measured quantity and is not encoded here. | variant: fast bin (10 keV–16.9 MeV) subdivided 8-way with a sqrt(E)·exp(−E/1.3 MeV) fission-spectrum within-bin weighting — sensitivity test for R11-01 (deep-tail reservoir mechanism); declared 3-bin integrals unchanged
